decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01, Location Plan received 30/10/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for a Pilates Studio (D2) only and this use shall not be carried on outside the following times:

8:00am-8:00pm Monday to Saturday.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, as amended, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification; the premises shall only be used for a Pilates Studio (D2) Use Class D2 without further approval in writing from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Change of use from B1 Office to D2 pilates Studio.
